title: Flipkart Products Scraper
description: Scrape public Flipkart search result data including product title, price, MRP, discount, rating, image, product ID, and URL. Defaults save one result for a low-cost test.

searchQueries.title: Search Queries
searchQueries.description: Product search terms such as iphone, laptop, shoes, or mixer grinder.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum products to save across all search queries. Start with 1 to keep usage low.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Maximum pages per query
maxPagesPerQuery.description: Bound page requests per keyword. Stops earlier at the result/spending limit or on a repeated page. Does not guarantee a monetary spending cap.

sortBy.title: Sort By
sortBy.description: Optional Flipkart sort order for search results.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: No paid proxy by default. Explicit Apify or custom proxies remain supported, with no automatic switch to a paid tier. Access depends on the source and IP; proxy traffic can increase costs, especially for one-product runs.
